basis: R011 H021, R012 H022 and R013 H023 had no independently reproducible candidate; the next batch must leave the geometry/structure family.
Astra's R013 audit proposed plaintext feedback as a distinct recurrence from H017 ciphertext neighbor difference.
H017 used a frozen training-only unigram score; H025 uses a separately fixed training-only bigram score so a shuffled plaintext negative is not accepted merely for preserving unigram counts.
hypothesis: LP2 encodes plaintext with page-reset first-order plaintext feedback: P[-1]=0, C[i]=(P[i]+P[i-1]) mod29; inverse P[i]=(C[i]-P[i-1]) mod29 should yield a sequence with detectable training-only bigram structure.
falsifiable_predictions: A verifier-only exact ciphertext formed by C[i]=(P[i]+P[i-1]) mod29 is recovered exactly by the worker, including P[0]=F, adjacent equal ciphertext values and page-boundary reset.

On a fixed actual-page-length synthetic gate, at least 18/20 positive natural-text cases score >= -5.9 after exact recovery, while 0/99 negatives across uniform ciphertext, wrong H017 cumulative feedback and shuffled plaintext score >= -5.9.

After the gate passes, the fixed recurrence over all 55 applicable LP2 pages has at least one maxT-adjusted p<=0.01 unit to count as a structural lead; otherwise the exact recurrence, scorer and within-page permutation null are negative only within scope.

sources.role: R014 forced method switch, three-direction comparison and H025 selection.
R013/H023 completion and three-round method-family boundary.
H017 ciphertext-difference boundary; H025 must not repeat its transform or score exclusion.
Existing scorer calibration boundary; H025 uses a new fixed bigram measurement with its own gate.
Pinned LP2 raw corpus, page order and applicability.
Frozen training-only bigram counts and weights.
Verifier-only natural-text windows for fixed synthetic gate positives.

applicable_objects: All 55 pages containing registered rune tokens, including rune portions of LP2/49 and LP2/51.

excluded_objects.reason: No registered rune tokens; the literal alphanumeric grid is not converted into the rune-domain feedback model.

representation: Original rune ordinal indices 0..28 only; non-rune characters remain in the raw source and do not update the plaintext feedback state.

transform.boundary: Reset P[-1]=0 at every applicable page; no row, paragraph, delimiter or chapter reset.
transform.f_policy: F is ordinary rune index 0; no copied-F exception, skip or key is added.
transform.literals: Non-rune characters do not enter the sequence and do not update the previous plaintext.

algorithm_version: H025-v1: page-reset plaintext-feedback recurrence, exact rune output, training-only bigram score, no key search or language completion.

scoring.score: Mean log-smoothed adjacent-pair weight over every decoded transition P[i-1],P[i]; weights are log((count+1)/(N_pairs+841)) from data/synthetic/training.txt only.
scoring.units: 55 page-reset LP2 units; one score per applicable page.
scoring.maxT: Standardize observed and 999 control score vectors together; compare each observed unit against the maximum control z across all 55 units with plus-one p and tie tolerance 1e-12.
scoring.lead: Complete controls, passed independent second-stage validation and maxT-adjusted p<=0.01; a lead is structural only.
scoring.negative: Complete controls, passed independent validation and no lead; scoped only to this exact recurrence, bigram weights and within-page ciphertext-permutation null.

power_gate.positive_source: Fixed windows of data/synthetic/heldout.txt at start=i*37, length from the pinned list; every positive has P[0]=0 and positive index 2 also has P[1]=0 to exercise a zero boundary.
power_gate.negative_design: Uniform random ciphertext; natural verifier-only windows encrypted by H017 cumulative C[i]=C[i-1]+P[i] mod29; and the same natural windows shuffled in rune order then encrypted by H025.
power_gate.acceptance: At least 18/20 positive exact decodes score >= -5.9 and 0/99 negatives score >= -5.9; classes are reported separately. This is a measurement gate, not an LP2 result.
power_gate.failure_action: Retain gate artifacts, mark inconclusive and do not dispatch LP2.

controls.random_null: For every applicable page, uniformly shuffle its complete ciphertext multiset within the page; preserve page length, rune multiset, page order and boundaries. Each replicate supplies one joint 55-unit score vector.
controls.dispatch: Gate-only public jobs are sent first; LP2 public jobs are constructed and dispatched only after gate status passed.
controls.independent: The worker decodes with its own recurrence; the orchestrator independently subtracts the previous decoded plaintext, recomputes every bigram score and encrypts verifier-only positives from the recovered plaintext.
controls.mutation: Changing a decoded rune, page identity, page order, score input or positive answer must fail independent verification.
controls.multiple_testing: One preregistered bigram-score statistic family with maxT across 55 valid pages; H017 unigram and H021-H023 structural statistics are not added.

randomness.role: The gate negative generator and page-permutation controls only; seeds and expected plaintext never enter the worker.

frozen_before_candidates: The runner writes this specification, all source/data hashes, gate-only public ciphertext jobs, verifier-only plaintext expectations, page order, code snapshot, bigram weights, threshold and seeds before worker execution; LP2 public jobs are written only after gate success.
independent_validation_path: A guarded worker receives only schema-valid public ciphertext. The verifier implements the recurrence directly, reconstructs C from positive P, recomputes bigram scores and checks exact job/page/rune coverage and output mutations.
timeout_policy: One 120-second monotonic deadline covers gate, optional LP2 worker, observations, controls, statistics and finalization. Each completed control row is appended to partial JSONL; an atomic checkpoint records count, partial hash, frozen hash, public hash, seed and RNG-state digest. Timeout is never negative.
uncovered_parameters: Other previous-plaintext initial values, feedback orders, mixed page/row reset policies and any key stream
H017 ciphertext difference, H016 external key/F exception, H026 word-block masks and H027 cross-page reuse
Multiplicative/PGL transforms, geometry, physical pixel layout and literal grid participation
Independent LP2 plaintext and image-level glyph audit
next_step: If a structural lead appears, freeze an independent page prediction before interpretation; if no lead appears, do not tune the recurrence, threshold or reset policy and choose a new non-geometric method family.
note: A high bigram score is a measurement lead, not a plaintext/key solution; reverse encryption consistency is necessary but not sufficient.
